ayahs.translationEn: In the name of God, The Most Gracious, The Dispenser of Grace:
All praise is due to God alone, the Sustainer of all the worlds,
The Most Gracious, the Dispenser of Grace,
Lord of the Day of Judgment!
Thee alone do we worship; and unto Thee alone do we turn for aid.
Guide us the straight way.

ayahs.arabic: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.translationEn: The way of those upon whom Thou hast bestowed Thy blessings, not of those who have been condemned [by Thee], nor of those who go astray!
ABOUT WHAT do they [most often] ask one another?
About the awesome tiding [of resurrection],
on which they [so utterly] disagree.
Nay, but in time they will come to understand [it]!
And once again: Nay, but in time they will come to understand!
HAVE WE NOT made the earth a resting-place [for you],
and the mountains [its] pegs?
And We have created you in pairs;
and We have made your sleep [a symbol of] death
and made the night [its] cloak
and made the day [a symbol of] life.
And We have built above you seven firmaments,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa banaina fauqakum sab 'an shi daada

ayahs.translationEn: and have placed [therein the sun,] a lamp full of blazing splendour.
And from the wind-driven clouds We send down waters pouring in abundance,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa anzalna minal m'usiraati maa-an saj-jaaja

ayahs.translationEn: so that We might bring forth thereby grain, and herbs,
ayahs.transliteration: Linukh rija bihee habbaw wana baata

ayahs.translationEn: and gardens dense with follage.
VERILY, the Day of Distinction [between the true and the false] has indeed its appointed time:

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
ayahs.translationEn: the Day when the trumpet [of resurrection] is sounded and you all come forward in multitudes;
ayahs.transliteration: Yauma yun fakhu fis-soori fataa toona afwaaja

ayahs.translationEn: and when the skies are opened and become [as wide-flung] gates;
ayahs.transliteration: Wa futiha tis samaa-u fakaanat abwaaba

ayahs.translationEn: and when the mountains are made to vanish as if they had been a mirage.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa suyyi raatil jibaalu fa kaanat saraaba

ayahs.translationEn: [On that Day,] verily, hell will lie in wait [for those who deny the truth] –
a goal for all who are wont to transgress the bounds of what is right!
In it shall they remain for a long time.

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
ayahs.translationEn: Neither coolness shall they taste therein nor any [thirst-quenching] drink –
ayahs.transliteration: Laa ya zooqoona feeha bar daw walaa sharaaba

ayahs.translationEn: only burning despair and ice-cold darkness:
a meet requital [for their sins]!
Behold, they were not expecting to be called to account,
having given the lie to Our messages one and all:
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kazzabu bi aayaa tina kizzaba

ayahs.translationEn: but We have placed on record every single thing [of what they did].
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kulla shai-in ahsai naahu kitaa ba

ayahs.translationEn: [And so We shall say:] "Taste, then, [the fruit of your evil doings,] for now We shall bestow on you nothing but more and more suffering!"
ayahs.transliteration: Fa zooqoo falan-nazee dakum ill-laa azaaba

ayahs.translationEn: [But,] verily for the God-conscious there is supreme fulfilment in store:
luxuriant gardens and vinyards,
and splendid companions well matched,
and a cup [of happiness] overflowing.

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
ayahs.translationEn: No empty talk will they hear in that [paradise], nor any lie.
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yasma'oona fiha lagh waw walaa kizzaba

ayahs.translationEn: [All this will be] a reward from thy Sustainer, a gift in accordance with [His Own] reckoning –

ayahs.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
ayahs.translationEn: [a reward from] the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Most Gracious! [And] none shall have it in their power to raise their voices unto Him
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbis samaa waati wal ardi wa maa baina humar rahmaani laa yam likoona minhu khi taaba

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
ayahs.translationEn: on the Day when all [human] souls and all the angels will stand up in ranks: none will speak but he to whom the Most Gracious will have given leave; and [everyone] will say [only] what is right.
ayahs.transliteration: Yauma yaqoo mur roohu wal malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yata kalla moona illa man azina lahur rahmaanu wa qaala sawaaba

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
ayahs.translationEn: That will be the Day of Ultimate Truth: whoever wills, then, let him take the path that leads towards his Sustainer!
ayahs.transliteration: Zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta khaaza ill-laa rabbihi ma-aaba

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
ayahs.translationEn: Verily, We have warned you of suffering near at hand - [suffering] on the Day when man shall [clearly] see what his hands have sent ahead, and when he who has denied the truth shall say, "Oh, would that I were mere dust...!"
ayahs.transliteration: In naa anzar naakum azaaban qareebaiy-yauma yan zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu wa ya qoolul-kaafiru yaa lai tanee kuntu turaaba

ayahs.translationEn: CONSIDER those [stars] that rise only to set,
and move [in their orbits] with steady motion,
and float [through space] with floating serene,
and yet overtake [one another] with swift overtaking:

words.translationEn: And those who race each other

ayahs.translationEn: and thus they fulfil the [Creator's] behest!
[HENCE, think of] the Day when a violent convulsion will convulse [the world],
to be followed by further [convulsions]!
On that Day will [men's] hearts be throbbing,
[and] their eyes downcast...
[And yet,] some say, "What! Are we indeed to be restored to our former state –
ayahs.transliteration: Ya qoo loona a-inna lamar doo doona fil haafirah

ayahs.translationEn: even though we may have become [a heap of] crumbling bones?"
[And] they add, "That, then, would be a return with loss!"
[But,] then, that [Last Hour] will be [upon them of a sudden, as if it were] but a single accusing cry -
and then, lo, they will be fully awakened [to the truth]!
HAS THE STORY of Moses ever come within thy ken.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
ayahs.translationEn: Lo! His Sustainer called out to him in the twice-hallowed valley:
ayahs.transliteration: Iz nadaahu rabbuhu bil waadil-muqad dasi tuwa

ayahs.translationEn: "Go unto Pharaoh - for, verily, he has transgressed all bounds of what is right -

ayahs.arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.translationEn: and say [unto him], 'Art thou desirous of attaining to purity?
[If so,] then I shall guide thee towards [a cognition of] thy Sustainer, so that [henceforth] thou wilt stand in awe [of Him].’"
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ahdi yaka ila rabbika fatakh sha

ayahs.translationEn: And thereupon he [went to Pharaoh and] made him aware of the great wonder [of God's grace].
But [Pharaoh] gave him the lie and rebelliously rejected [all guidance],
and brusquely turned his back [on Moses];
and then he gathered [his great ones], and called [unto his people],
and said, "I am your Lord All-Highest!"
And thereupon God took him to task, [and made him] a warning example in the life to come as well as in this world.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-akha zahul laahu nakalal aakhirati wal-oola.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
ayahs.translationEn: In this, behold, there is a lesson indeed for all who stand in awe [of God].

ayahs.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
ayahs.translationEn: [O MEN!] Are you more difficult to create than the heaven which He has built?
ayahs.transliteration: A-antum a shaddu khalqan amis samaa-u banaaha.

ayahs.translationEn: High has He reared its vault and formed it in accordance with what it was meant to be;
and He has made dark its night and brought forth its light of day.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa aghtasha lailaha wa akhraja duhaaha.

ayahs.translationEn: And after that, the earth: wide has He spread its expanse,
and has caused its waters to come out of it, and its pastures,
and has made the mountains firm:
[all this] as a means of livelihood for you and your animals.
AND SO, when the great overwhelming event [of, resurrection] comes to pass –
on that Day man will [clearly] remember all that he has ever wrought;
ayahs.transliteration: Yauma Yata zakkarul insaanu ma sa'aa.

ayahs.translationEn: and the blazing fire [of hell] will be lad open before all who [are destined to] see it.
For, unto him who shall have transgressed the bounds of what is right,
and preferred the life of this world [to the good of his soul],
that blazing fire will truly be the goal!

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
ayahs.translationEn: But unto him who shall have stood in fear of his Sustainer's Presence, and held back his inner self from base desires,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ammaa man khaafa maqaama Rabbihee wa nahan nafsa 'anil hawaa

ayahs.translationEn: paradise will truly be the goal!
THEY WILL ASK thee [O Prophet] about the Last Hour: "When will it come to pass?"
[But] how couldst thou tell anything about it,
[seeing that] with thy Sustainer alone rests the beginning and the end [of all knowledge] thereof?
Thou art but [sent] to warn those who stand in awe of it.

ayahs.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.translationEn: On the Day when they behold it, [it will seem to them] as if they had tarried [in this world] no longer than one evening or [one night, ending with] its morn!
ayahs.transliteration: Ka annahum Yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasooo illaa 'ashiyyatan aw duhaahaa

ayahs.translationEn: HE FROWNED and turned away
because the blind man approached him!
Yet for all thou didst know, [O Muhammad,] he might perhaps have grown in purity,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa yudreeka la'allahu yaz zakkaa.

ayahs.translationEn: or have been reminded [of the truth], and helped by this reminder.
ayahs.transliteration: Au yaz zak karu fatanfa 'ahuz zikraa.

ayahs.translationEn: Now as for him who believes himself to be self-sufficient
to him didst thou give thy whole attention,
although thou art not accountable for his failure to attain to purity;
but as for him who came unto thee full of eagerness
and in awe [of God]
him didst thou disregard!
NAY, VERILY, these [messages] are but a reminder:
and so, whoever is willing may remember Him
in [the light of His] revelations blest with dignity,
lofty and pure,
[borne] by the hands of messengers
noble and most virtuous.
[But only too often] man destroys himself: how stubbornly does he deny the truth!
[Does man ever consider] out of what substance [God] creates him?
Out of a drop of sperm He creates him, and thereupon determines his nature,
and then makes it easy for him to go through life;
and in the end He causes him to die and brings him to the grave;

words.translationEn: and provides a grave for him

ayahs.translationEn: and then, if it be His will, He shall raise him again to life,
Nay, but [man] has never yet fulfilled what He has enjoined upon him!
Let man, then, consider [the sources of] his food:
[how it is] that We pour down water, pouring it down abundantly;
and then We cleave the earth [with new growth], cleaving it asunder,
and thereupon We cause grain to grow out of it,
and vines and edible plants,
and olive trees and date-palms,
and gardens dense with foliage,
and fruits and herbage,
for you and for your animals to enjoy.
AND SO, when the piercing call [of resurrection] is heard
on a Day when everyone will [want to] flee from his brother,
and from his mother and father,
and from his spouse and his children:

ayahs.arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ
ayahs.translationEn: on that Day, to every one of them will his own state be of sufficient concern.
Some faces will on that Day be bright with happiness,
laughing, rejoicing at glad tidings.
And some faces will on that Day with dust be covered,
with darkness overspread:
these, these will be the ones who denied the truth and were immersed in iniquity!
WHEN THE SUN is shrouded in darkness,
and when the stars lose their light,
and when the mountains are made to vanish,
and when she-camels big with young, about to give birth, are left untended,
and when all beasts are gathered together,
and when the seas boil over,
and when all human beings are coupled [with their deeds],
and when the girl-child that was buried alive is made to ask
for what crime she had been slain,
and when the scrolls [of men's deeds] are unfolded,
and when heaven is laid bare,
and when the blazing fire [of hell] is kindled bright,
and when paradise is brought into view:
[on that Day] every human being will come to know what he has prepared [for himself].
BUT NAY! I call to witness the revolving stars,
the planets that run their course and set,
and the night as it darkly falls,
and the morn as it softly breathes:
behold, this [divine writ] is indeed the [inspired] word of a noble apostle,

ayahs.arabic: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ
ayahs.translationEn: with strength endowed, secure with Him who in almightiness is enthroned
[the word] of one to be heeded, and worthy of trust!
For, this fellow-man of yours is not a madman:
he truly beheld [the angel - beheld] him on the clear horizon;
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laqad ra aahu bilufuqil mubeen

ayahs.translationEn: and he is not one to begrudge others the knowledge [of whatever has been revealed to him] out of that which is beyond the reach of human Perception.
Nor is this [message] the word of any satanic force accursed.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa huwa biqawli shaitaanir rajeem

ayahs.translationEn: Whither, then, will you go?
This [message] is no less than a reminder to all mankind –
to everyone of you who wills to walk a straight way.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translationEn: But you cannot will it unless God, the Sustainer of all the worlds, wills [to show you that way].
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa tashaaa'oona illaaa ai yashaaa 'al laahu Rabbul 'Aalameen

ayahs.translationEn: WHEN THE SKY is cleft asunder,
and when the stars are scattered,
and when the seas burst beyond their bounds,
and when the graves are overturned –
every human being will [at last] comprehend, what he has sent ahead and what he has held back [in this world].

ayahs.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
ayahs.translationEn: O MAN! What is it that lures thee away from thy bountiful Sustainer,
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa ayyuhal insaaanu maa gharraka bi Rabbikal kareem

ayahs.translationEn: who has created thee, and formed thee in accordance with what thou art meant' to be, and shaped thy nature in just proportions,

ayahs.arabic: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ayahs.translationEn: having put thee together in whatever form He willed [thee to have]?
ayahs.transliteration: Feee ayye sooratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak

ayahs.translationEn: Nay, [O men,] but you [are lured away from God whenever you are tempted to] give the lie to [God’s] Judgment!
And yet, verily, there are ever-watchful forces over you,
noble, recording,
aware of whatever you do!
Behold, [in the life to come] the truly virtuous: will indeed be in bliss,
whereas, behold, the wicked will indeed be in a blazing fire –
[a fire] which they shall enter on Judgment Day,
and which they shall not [be able to] evade.
And what could make thee conceive what that Judgment Day will be?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translationEn: And once again: What could make thee conceive what that Judgment Day will be?
ayahs.transliteration: Summa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
ayahs.translationEn: [It will be] a Day when no human being shall be of the least avail to another human being: for on that Day [it will become manifest that] all sovereignty is God's alone.
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma laa tamliku nafsul linafsin shai'anw walamru yawma'izil lillaah

ayahs.translationEn: WOE UNTO THOSE who give short measure:

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
ayahs.translationEn: those who, when they are to receive their due from [other] people, demand that it be given in full –
but when they have to measure or weigh whatever they owe to others, give less than what is due!
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa kaaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroon

ayahs.translationEn: Do they not know that they are bound to be raised from the dead
[and called to account] on an awesome Day –
the Day when all men shall stand before the Sustainer of all the worlds?

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
ayahs.translationEn: NAY, VERILY, the record of the wicked is indeed [set down] in a mode inescapable!
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaaa inna kitaabal fujjaari lafee Sijjeen

ayahs.translationEn: And what could make thee conceive what that that mode inescapable will be?
A record [indelibly] inscribed!
Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth –
those who give the lie to the [coming of] Judgment Day:

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayahs.translationEn: for, none gives the lie to it but such as are wont to transgress against all that is [and are] immersed in sin:
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa yukazzibu biheee illaa kullu mu'tadin aseem

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translationEn: [and so,] whenever Our messages are conveyed to them, they but say, "Fables of ancient times!"
ayahs.transliteration: Izaa tutlaa'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.translationEn: Nay, but their hearts are corroded by all [the evil] that they were wont to do!
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaa bal raana 'alaa quloobihim maa kaanoo yaksiboon

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
ayahs.translationEn: Nay, verily, from [the grace of] their Sustainer shall they on that Day be debarred;
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaaa innahum 'ar Rabbihim yawma'izil lamah jooboon

ayahs.translationEn: and then, behold, they shall enter the blazing fire

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.translationEn: and be told: "This is the [very thing] to which you were wont to give the lie!"
ayahs.transliteration: Summa yuqaalu haazal lazee kuntum bihee tukazziboon

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
ayahs.translationEn: NAY, VERILY - the record of the truly virtuous is [set down] in a mode most lofty!
And what could make thee conceive what that mode most lofty will be?
A record [indelibly] inscribed,
witnessed~ by all who have [ever] been drawn close unto God.
Behold, [in the life to come] the truly virtuous will indeed be in bliss:
[resting on couches, they will look up [to God]:
upon their faces thou wilt see the brightness of bliss.
They will be given a drink of pure wine whereon the seal [of God] will have been set,

words.translationEn: They will be given to drink

ayahs.arabic: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
ayahs.translationEn: pouring forth with a fragrance of musk. To that [wine of paradise], then, let all such aspire as [are willing to] aspire to things of high account:
ayahs.transliteration: Khitaamuhoo misk; wa fee zaalika falyatanaafasil Mutanaafisoon

ayahs.translationEn: for it is composed of all that is most exalting
a source [of bliss] whereof those who are drawn close unto God shall drink.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.translationEn: BEHOLD, those who have abandoned themselves to sin are wont to laugh at such as have attained to faith
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena ajramoo kaanoo minal lazeena aamanoo yadhakoon

ayahs.translationEn: and whenever they pass by them, they wink at one another [derisively];

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
ayahs.translationEn: and whenever they return to people of their own kind, they return full of jests;
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izan qalabooo ilaaa ahlihimun qalaboo fakiheen

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
ayahs.translationEn: and whenever they see those [who believe,] they say, "Behold, these [people] have indeed gone astray!"
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa ra awhum qaalooo inna haaa'ulaaa'i ladaaal loon

ayahs.translationEn: And, withal, they have no call to watch over [the beliefs of] others...

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.translationEn: But on the Day [of Judgment], they who had attained to faith will [be able to] laugh at the [erstwhile] deniers of the truth:
ayahs.transliteration: Fal yawmal lazeena aamanoo minal kuffaari yadhakoon

ayahs.translationEn: [for, resting in paradise] on couches, they will look on [and say to themselves]:

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.translationEn: "Are these deniers of the truth being [thus] requited for [aught but] what they were wont to do?"
ayahs.transliteration: Hal suwwibal kuffaaru maa kaanoo yaf'aloon

ayahs.translationEn: WHEN THE SKY is split asunder,
obeying its Sustainer, as in truth it must;
ayahs.transliteration: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat

ayahs.translationEn: and when the earth is leveled,
and casts forth whatever is in it, and becomes utterly void,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa alqat maa feehaa wa takhallat

ayahs.translationEn: obeying its Sustainer, as in truth it must -:
ayahs.transliteration: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat

ayahs.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
ayahs.translationEn: [then,] O man - thou [that] hast, verily, been toiling towards thy Sustainer in painful toil - then shalt thou meet Him!
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa ayyuhal insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa Rabbika kad han famulaaqeeh

ayahs.translationEn: And as for him whose record shall be placed in his right hand,
ayahs.transliteration: Fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenih

ayahs.translationEn: he will in time be called to account with an easy accounting,
and will [be able to] turn joyfully to those of his own kind.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
ayahs.translationEn: But as for him whose record shall be given to him behind his back;
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo waraaa'a zahrih

ayahs.translationEn: he will in time pray for utter destruction:
but he will enter the blazing flame.
Behold, [in his earthly life] he lived joyfully among people of his own kind
for, behold, he never thought that he would have to return [to God].

ayahs.arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا
ayahs.translationEn: Yea indeed! His Sustainer did see all that was in him!
ayahs.transliteration: Balaaa inna Rabbahoo kaana bihee baseeraa

ayahs.translationEn: BUT NAY! I call to witness the sunset's [fleeting] afterglow,
and the night, and what it [step by step] unfolds,
and the moon, as it grows to its fullness:
[even thus, O men,] are you bound to move; onward from stage to stage.
What, then, is amiss with them that they will not believe [in a life to come]?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
ayahs.translationEn: and [that], when the Qur’an is read unto them, they do not fall down in prostration?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa quri'a 'alaihimul Quraanu laa yasjudoon

ayahs.translationEn: Nay, but they who are bent on denying the truth give the lie [to this divine writ]!
Yet God has full knowledge of what they conceal [in their hearts].
Hence, give them the tiding of grievous suffering [in the life to come] –

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
ayahs.translationEn: unless it be such [of them] as [repent, and] attain to faith, and do good works: for theirs shall be a reward unending!.
ayahs.transliteration: Illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon

ayahs.translationEn: CONSIDER the sky full of great constellations,
and [then bethink thyself of] the promised Day,
and [of] Him who witnesses [all], and [of] that unto which witness is borne [by Him]!
THEY DESTROY [but] themselves, they who would ready a pit
of fire fiercely burning [for all who have attained to faith]!
Lo! [With glee do] they contemplate that [fire],

ayahs.arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
ayahs.translationEn: fully conscious of what they are doing to the believers,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa hum 'alaa maa yaf'aloona bilmu 'mineena shuhood

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
ayahs.translationEn: whom they hate for no other reason than that they believe in God, the Almighty, the One to whom all praise is due,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa naqamoo minhum illaaa aiyu'minoo billaahil 'azeezil Hameed

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.translationEn: [and] to whom the dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs. But God is witness unto everything!
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ard; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai 'in Shaheed

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
ayahs.translationEn: Verily, as for those who persecute believing men and believing women, and thereafter do not repent, hell's suffering awaits them: yea, suffering through fire awaits them!
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena fatanul mu'mineena wal mu'minaati summa lam yatooboo falahum 'azaabu Jahannama wa lahum 'azaabul hareeq

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
ayahs.translationEn: [But,] verily, they who attain to faith and do righteous deeds shall [in the life to come] have gardens through which running waters flow - that triumph most great!
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum Jannaatun tajree min tahtihal anhaar; zaalikal fawzul kabeer

ayahs.translationEn: VERILY, thy Sustainer's grip is exceedingly strong!
Behold, it is He who creates [man] in the first instance, and He [it is who] will bring him forth anew.
And He alone is truly-forgiving, all-embracing in His love,
in sublime almightiness enthroned,
a sovereign doer of whatever He wills.
HAS IT ever come within thy ken, the story of the [sinful] hosts
of Pharaoh, and of [the tribe of] Thamud?
And yet, they who are bent on denying the truth persist in giving it the lie:
but all the while God encompasses them [with His knowledge and might] without their being aware of it.
Nay, but this [divine writ which they reject] is a discourse sublime,
upon an imperishable tablet [inscribed].
CONSIDER the heavens and that which comes in the night!
And what could make thee conceive what it is that comes in the night?
It is the star that pierces through [life's] darkness:

ayahs.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
ayahs.translationEn: [for] no human being has ever been left unguarded.
LET MAN, then, observe out of what he has been created:
he has been created out of a seminal fluid
issuing from between the loins [of man] and the pelvic arch [of woman].
Now, verily, He [who thus creates man in the first instance] is well able to bring him back [to life]
on the Day when all secrets will be laid bare,

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
ayahs.translationEn: and [man] will have neither strength nor helper!
ayahs.transliteration: Famaa lahoo min quwwatinw wa laa naasir

ayahs.translationEn: Consider the heavens, ever-revolving,
and the earth, bursting forth with plants!
BEHOLD, this [divine writ] is indeed a word that between truth and falsehood,
and is no idle tale.
Behold, they [who refuse to accept it] devise many a false argument [to disprove its truth];
but I shall bring all their scheming to nought.
Let, then, the deniers of the truth have their will: let them have their will for a little while.
EXTOL the limitless glory of thy Sustainer's name: [the glory of] the Al-Highest,
who creates [every thing], and thereupon forms it in accordance with what it is meant to be,
and who determines the nature [of all that exists], and thereupon guides it [towards its fulfilment],
and who brings forth herbage,
and thereupon causes it to decay into rust-brown stubble!
WE SHALL teach thee, and thou wilt not forget [aught of what thou art taught],

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
ayahs.translationEn: save what God may will [thee to forget] - for, verily, He [alone] knows all that is open to [man's] perception as well as all that is hidden [from it]
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa maa shaaa'al laah; innahoo ya'lamul jahra wa maa yakhfaa

ayahs.translationEn: and [thus] shall We make easy for thee the path towards [ultimate] ease.
REMIND, THEN, [others of the truth, regardless of] whether this reminding [would seem to] be of use [or not]:
in mind will keep it he who stands in awe [of God],
but aloof from it will remain that most hapless wretch –
he who [in the life to come] shall have to endure the great fire

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
ayahs.translationEn: wherein he will neither die nor remain alive.
ayahs.transliteration: Summa laa yamootu feehaa wa laa yahyaa

ayahs.translationEn: To happiness [in the life to come] will indeed attain he who attains to purity [in this world],
and remembers his Sustainer's name, and prays [unto Him].
But nay, [O men,] you prefer the life of this world,
although the life to come is better and more enduring.
Verily, [all] this has indeed been [said] in the earlier revelations –
ayahs.transliteration: Inna haazaa lafis suhu fil oolaa

ayahs.translationEn: the revelations of Abraham and Moses.
HAS THERE COME unto thee the tiding of the Overshadowing Event?'
Some faces will on that Day be downcast,
toiling [under burdens of sin], worn out [by fear],
about to enter a glowing fire,
given to drink from a boiling spring.

words.translationEn: They will be given to drink

ayahs.arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ
ayahs.translationEn: No food for them save the bitterness of dry thorns,
ayahs.transliteration: Laisa lahum ta'aamun illaa min daree'

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ
ayahs.translationEn: which gives no strength and neither stills hunger.
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yusminu wa laa yughnee min joo'

ayahs.translationEn: [And] some faces will on that Day shine with bliss,
well-pleased with [the fruit of] their striving,
in a garden sublime,
wherein thou wilt hear no empty talk.
Countless springs will flow therein,
[and] there will be thrones [of happiness] raised high,
and goblets placed ready,
and cushions ranged,
and carpets spread out…

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
ayahs.translationEn: DO, THEN, they [who deny resurrection] never gaze at the clouds pregnant with water, [and observe] how they are created?
And at the sky, how it is raised aloft?
And at the mountains, how firmly they are reared?
And at the earth, how it is spread out?
And so, [O Prophet,] exhort them; thy task is only to exhort:
thou canst not compel them [to believe].
However, as for him who turns away, being bent on denying the truth,
him will God cause to suffer the greatest suffering [in the life to come]:
for behold, unto Us will be their return,
and verily, It is for Us to call them to account.
CONSIDER the daybreak
and the ten nights!
Consider the multiple and the One!
Consider the night as it runs its course!

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
ayahs.translationEn: Considering all this - could there be, to anyone endowed with reason, a [more] solemn evidence of the truth?
ayahs.transliteration: Hal fee zaalika qasamul lizee hijr

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
ayahs.translationEn: ART THOU NOT aware of how thy Sustainer has dealt with [the tribe of] ‘Ad,
ayahs.transliteration: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi'aad

ayahs.translationEn: [the people of] Iram the many-pillared,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
ayahs.translationEn: the like of whom has never been reared in all the land? –
ayahs.transliteration: Allatee lam yukhlaq misluhaa fil bilaad

ayahs.translationEn: and with [the tribe of] Thamud, who hollowed out rocks in the valley? –
ayahs.transliteration: Wa samoodal lazeena jaabus sakhra bil waad

ayahs.translationEn: and with Pharaoh of the [many] tent-poles?
[It was they] who transgressed all bounds of equity all over their lands,
and brought about great corruption therein:
and therefore thy Sustainer let loose upon them a scourge of suffering:
for, verily, thy Sustainer is ever on the watch!

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
ayahs.translationEn: BUT AS FOR man, whenever his Sustainer tries him by His generosity and by letting him enjoy a life of ease, he says, "My Sustainer has been [justly] generous towards me";
ayahs.transliteration: Fa ammal insaanu izaa mab talaahu Rabbuhoo fa akramahoo wa na' 'amahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee akraman

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
ayahs.translationEn: whereas, whenever He tries him by straitening his means of livelihood, he says, "My Sustainer has disgraced me!"
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ammaaa izaa mabtalaahu faqadara 'alaihi rizqahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee ahaanan

ayahs.translationEn: But nay, nay, [O men, consider all that you do and fail to do:] you are not generous towards the orphan,
ayahs.transliteration: Kalla bal laa tukrimooo nal yateem

ayahs.translationEn: and you do not urge one another to feed the needy,
and you devour the inheritance [of others] with devouring greed,
and you love wealth with boundless love!

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا
ayahs.translationEn: Nay, but [how will you fare on Judgment Day,] when the earth is crushed with crushing upon crushing,
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaaa izaaa dukkatil ardu dakkan dakka

ayahs.translationEn: and [the majesty of] thy Sustainer stands revealed, as well as [the true nature of] the angels; rank upon rank?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa jaaa'a Rabbuka wal malaku saffan saffaa

ayahs.arabic: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
ayahs.translationEn: And on that Day hell will be brought [within sight]; on that Day man will remember [all that he did and failed to do]: but what will that remembrance avail him?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa jeee'a yawma'izim bi jahannnam; Yawma 'iziny yatazakkarul insaanu wa annaa lahuz zikraa

ayahs.translationEn: He will say, "Oh, would that I had. provided beforehand for my life [to come]!"
For, none can make suffer as He will make suffer [the sinners] on that Day,
ayahs.transliteration: Fa Yawma izil laa yu'azzibu 'azaabahooo ahad

ayahs.translationEn: and none can bind with bonds like His.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laa yoosiqu wasaaqa hooo ahad

ayahs.translationEn: [But unto the righteous God will say,] "O thou human being that hast attained to inner peace!
Return thou unto thy Sustainer, well-pleased [and] pleasing [Him]:
enter, then, together with My [other true] servants –
yea, enter thou My paradise!"
NAY! I call to witness this land –
this land in which thou art free to dwell -
and [I call to witness] parent and offspring:
Verily, We have created man into [a life of] pain, toil and trial.

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ
ayahs.translationEn: Does he, then, think that no one has power over him?
He boasts, "I have spent wealth abundant!"
Does he, then, think that no one sees him?
Have We not given him two eyes,
and a tongue, and a pair of lips,
and shown him the two highways [of good and evil]?
But he would not try to ascend the steep uphill road...
And what could make thee conceive what it is, that steep uphill road?
[It is] the freeing of one's neck [from the burden of sin],

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ إِطْعَـٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
ayahs.translationEn: or the feeding, upon a day of [one's own] hunger,
ayahs.transliteration: Aw it'aamun fee yawmin zee masghabah

ayahs.translationEn: of an orphan near of kin,
or of a needy [stranger] lying in the dust –

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
ayahs.translationEn: and being, withal, of those who have attained to faith, and who enjoin upon one another patience in adversity, and enjoin upon one another compassion.
ayahs.transliteration: Summa kaana minal lazeena aamanoo wa tawaasaw bissabri wa tawaasaw bilmarhamah

ayahs.translationEn: Such are they that have attained to righteousness;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
ayahs.translationEn: whereas those who are bent on denying the truth of Our messages – they are such as have lost themselves in evil,
ayahs.transliteration: Wallazeena kafaroo bi aayaatinaa hum as-haabul Mash'amah

ayahs.translationEn: [with] fire closing in upon them.
CONSIDER the sun and its radiant brightness,
and the moon as it reflects the sun!
Consider the day as it reveals the world,
and the night as it veils it darkly!
Consider the sky and its wondrous make,
and the earth and all its expanse!
Consider the human self, and how it is formed in accordance with what it is meant to be,
and how it is imbued with moral failings as well as with consciousness of God!
To a happy state shall indeed attain he who causes this [self] to grow in purity,
and truly lost is he who buries it [in darkness].
TO [THIS] TRUTH gave the lie, in their overweening arrogance, [the tribe of] Thamud,
when that most hapless wretch from among them rushed forward [to commit his evil deed],

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
ayahs.translationEn: although God's apostle had told them, "It is a she-camel belonging to God, so let her drink [and do her no harm]!"
ayahs.transliteration: Faqaala lahum Rasoolul laahi naaqatal laahi wa suqiyaahaa

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.translationEn: But they gave him the lie, and cruelly slaughtered her - whereupon their Sustainer visited them with utter destruction for this their sin, destroying them all alike:
ayahs.transliteration: Fakazzaboohu fa'aqaroohaa fadamdama 'alaihim Rabbuhum bizambihim fasaw waahaa

ayahs.translationEn: for none [of them] had any fear of what might befall them.
CONSIDER the night as it veils [the earth] in darkness,
and the day as it rises bright!
Consider the creation of the male and the female!
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa khalaqaz zakara wal unthaa

ayahs.translationEn: Verily, [O men,] you aim at most divergent ends!
Thus, as for him who gives [to others] and is conscious of God,
and believes in the truth of the ultimate good
for him shall We make easy the path towards [ultimate] ease.
But as for him who is niggardly, and thinks that he is self-sufficient,

words.translationEn: and considers himself free from need

ayahs.translationEn: and calls the ultimate good a lie –
for him shall We make easy the path towards hardship:

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
ayahs.translationEn: and what will his wealth avail him when he goes down [to his grave]?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa yughnee 'anhu maaluhooo izaa taraddaa

ayahs.translationEn: BEHOLD, it is indeed for Us to grace [you] with guidance;
and, behold, Ours is [the dominion over] the life to come as well as [over] this earlier part [of your life]:
ayahs.transliteration: Wa inna lanaa lal Aakhirata wal oolaa

ayahs.translationEn: and so I warn you of the raging fire -
[the fire] which none shall have to endure but that most hapless wretch
who gives the lie to the truth and turns away [from it].
For, distant from it shall remain he who is truly conscious of God:

words.translationEn: But will be removed from it

ayahs.translationEn: he that spends his possessions [on others] so that he might grow in purity –

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
ayahs.translationEn: not as payment for favours received,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa li ahadin 'indahoo min ni'matin tujzaaa

ayahs.translationEn: but only out of a longing for the countenance of his Sustainer, the All-Highest:
and such, indeed, shall in time be well-pleased.
CONSIDER the bright morning hours,
and the night when it grows still and dark.
Thy Sustainer has not forsaken thee, nor does He scorn thee:
ayahs.transliteration: Ma wad da'aka rabbuka wa ma qalaa

ayahs.translationEn: for, indeed, the life to come will be better for thee than this earlier part [of thy life]!
And, indeed, in time will thy Sustainer grant thee [what thy heart desires], and thou shalt be well-pleased.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa la sawfa y'uteeka rabbuka fatarda

ayahs.translationEn: Has He not found thee an orphan, and given thee shelter?
ayahs.transliteration: Alam ya jidka yateeman fa aawaa

ayahs.translationEn: And found thee lost on thy way, and guided thee?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa wa jadaka daal lan fahada

ayahs.translationEn: And found thee in want, and given thee sufficiency?
Therefore, the orphan shalt thou never wrong,
ayahs.transliteration: Fa am mal yateema fala taqhar

ayahs.translationEn: and him that seeks [thy] help shalt thou never chide,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa am mas saa-ila fala tanhar

ayahs.translationEn: and of thy Sustainer's blessings shalt thou [ever] speak.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa amma bi ni'mati rabbika fahad dith

ayahs.translationEn: HAVE WE NOT opened up thy heart,
and lifted from thee the burden
that had weighed so heavily on thy back?
And [have We not] raised thee high in dignity?
And, behold, with every hardship comes ease:
verily, with every hardship comes ease!
Hence, when thou art freed [from distress], remain steadfast,
and unto thy Sustainer turn with love.
CONSIDER the fig and the olive,
and Mount Sinai,
and this land secure!

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translationEn: Verily, We create man in the best conformation;
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee ahsani taqweem

ayahs.translationEn: and thereafter We reduce him to the lowest of low
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma ra dad naahu asfala saafileen

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.translationEn: excepting only such as attain to faith and do good works: and theirs shall be a reward unending!
ayahs.transliteration: Ill-lal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati; falahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon

ayahs.translationEn: What, then, [O man,] could henceforth cause thee to give the lie to this moral law?
ayahs.transliteration: Fama yu kaz zibuka b'adu bid deen

ayahs.translationEn: Is not God the most just of judges?
READ in the name of thy Sustainer, who has-
ayahs.transliteration: Iqra bismi rab bikal lazee khalaq

ayahs.translationEn: created man out of a germ-cell
Read - for thy Sustainer is the Most Bountiful One
who has taught [man] the use of the pen –
taught man what he did not know!
Nay, verily, man becomes grossly overweening
whenever he believes himself to be self-sufficient:
for, behold, unto thy Sustainer all must return.
HAST THOU ever considered him who tries to prevent
a servant [of God] from praying?
Hast thou considered whether he is on the right way,
or is concerned with God-consciousness?
Hast thou considered whether he may [not] be giving the lie to the truth and turning his back [upon it]?
ayahs.transliteration: Ara-aita in kaz zaba wa ta walla

ayahs.translationEn: Does he, then, not know that God sees [all]?
ayahs.transliteration: Alam y'alam bi-an nal lahaa yaraa

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
ayahs.translationEn: Nay, if he desist not, We shall most surely drag him down upon his forehead
ayahs.transliteration: Kalla la illam yantahi la nasfa'am bin nasiyah

ayahs.translationEn: the lying, rebellious forehead! –
and then let him summon [to his aid] the counsels of his own [spurious] wisdom,
[the while] We shall summon the forces of heavenly chastisement!
Nay, pay thou no heed to him, but prostrate thyself [before God] and draw close [unto Him]!
BEHOLD, from on high have We bestowed this [divine writ] on Night of Destiny.
And what could make thee conceive what it is, that Night of Destiny?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa adraaka ma lailatul qadr

ayahs.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
ayahs.translationEn: The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months:
ayahs.transliteration: Lailatul qadri khairum min alfee shahr

ayahs.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
ayahs.translationEn: in hosts descend in it the angels, bearing divine inspiration by their Sustainer's leave; from all [evil] that may happen
ayahs.transliteration: Tanaz zalul malaa-ikatu war roohu feeha bi izni-rab bihim min kulli amr

ayahs.translationEn: does it make secure, until the rise of dawn.
ayahs.transliteration: Salaamun hiya hattaa mat la'il fajr

ayahs.arabic: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
ayahs.translationEn: IT IS NOT [conceivable] that such as are bent on denying the truth - [be they] from among the followers of earlier revelation or from among those who ascribe divinity to aught beside God should ever be abandoned [by Him] ere there comes unto them the [full] evidence of the truth:
ayahs.transliteration: Lam ya kunil lazeena kafaru min ahlil kitaabi wal mushri keena mun fak keena hattaa ta-tiya humul bayyinah

ayahs.arabic: رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ
ayahs.translationEn: an apostle from God, conveying [unto them] revelations blest with purity,
ayahs.transliteration: Rasoolum minal laahi yatlu suhufam mutahharah

ayahs.translationEn: wherein there are ordinances of ever-true soundness and clarity.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
ayahs.translationEn: Now those who have been vouchsafed revelation aforetime did break up their unity [of faith] after such an evidence of the truth had come to them.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa tafarraqal lazeena ootul kitaaba il-la mim b'adi ma jaa-at humul baiyyinah

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
ayahs.translationEn: And withal, they were not enjoined aught but that they should worship God, sincere in their faith in Him alone, turning away from all that is false; and that they should be constant in prayer; and that they should spend in charity: for this is a moral law endowed with ever-true soundness and clarity.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa umiroo il-la liy'abu dul laaha mukhliseena lahud-deena huna faa-a wa yuqeemus salaahta wa yu-tuz zakaata; wa zaalika deenul qaiyimah

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
ayahs.translationEn: Verily, those who [despite all evidence] are bent on denying the truth - [be they] from among the followers of earlier revelation or from among those who ascribe divinity to aught beside God - will find themselves in the fire of hell, therein to abide: they are the worst of all creatures.
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena kafaru min ahlil kitaabi wal mushri keena fee nari jahan nama khaali deena feeha; ulaa-ika hum shar rul ba reeyah

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
ayahs.translationEn: [And,] verily, those who have attained to faith, and do righteous deeds - it is they, they who are the best of all creatures.
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena aamanu wa 'amilus saalihaati ula-ika hum khairul bareey yah

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
ayahs.translationEn: Their reward [awaits them] with God: gardens of perpetual bliss, through which running waters flow, therein to abide beyond the count of time; well-pleased is God with them, and well-pleased are they with Him: all this awaits him who of his Sustainer stands in awe!.
ayahs.transliteration: Jazaa-uhum inda rabbihim jan naatu 'adnin tajree min tahtihal an haaru khalideena feeha abada; radiy-yallaahu 'anhum wa ra du 'an zaalika liman khashiya rabbah.

ayahs.translationEn: WHEN THE EARTH quakes with her [last] mighty quaking,
ayahs.transliteration: Izaa zul zilatil ardu zil zaalaha

ayahs.translationEn: and [when] the earth yields up her burdens,
and man cries out, "What has happened to her?" -
on that Day will she recount all her tidings,
as thy Sustainer will have inspired her to do!

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
ayahs.translationEn: On that Day will all men come forward, cut off from one another, to be shown their [past] deeds.
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma iziy yas durun naasu ash tatal liyuraw a'maalahum

ayahs.arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translationEn: And so, he who shall have done an atom's weight of good, shall behold it;
ayahs.transliteration: Famaiy ya'mal mithqala zarratin khai raiy-yarah

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translationEn: and he who shall have done an atom's weight of evil, shall behold it.
Oh, the chargers that run panting,
sparks of fire striking,
rushing to assault at morn,
thereby raising clouds of dust,
thereby storming [blindly] into any host!
VERILY, towards his Sustainer man is most ungrateful
and to this, behold, he [himself] bears witness indeed:
for, verily, to the love of wealth is he most ardently devoted.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa innahu lihubbil khairi la shadeed

ayahs.arabic: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
ayahs.translationEn: But does he not know that [on the Last Day,] when all that is in the graves is raised and brought out,
ayahs.transliteration: Afala ya'lamu iza b'uthira ma filquboor

ayahs.translationEn: and all that is [hidden] in men's hearts is bared
that on that Day their Sustainer [will show that He] has always been fully aware of them?
ayahs.transliteration: Inna rabbahum bihim yauma 'izil la khabeer

ayahs.translationEn: OH, the sudden calamity!
How awesome the sudden calamity!
And what could make thee conceive what that sudden calamity will be?
[It will occur] on the Day when men will be like moths swarming in confusion,
ayahs.transliteration: Yauma ya koonun naasu kal farashil mabthooth

ayahs.translationEn: and the mountains will be like fluffy tufts of wool....
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ta koonul jibalu kal 'ihnil manfoosh

ayahs.translationEn: And then, he whose weight [of good deeds] is heavy in the balance
shall find himself in a happy' state of life;
whereas he whose weight is light in the balance
ayahs.transliteration: Wa amma man khaffat mawa zeenuh

ayahs.translationEn: shall be engulfed by an abyss.
And what could make thee conceive what that [abyss] will be?
A fire hotly burning!
YOU ARE OBSESSED by greed for more and more
until you go down to your graves.
Nay, in time you will come to understand!
And once again: Nay, in time you will come to understand!
Nay, if you could but understand [it] with an understanding [born] of certainty,
you would indeed, most surely, behold the blazing fire [of hell]!
In the end you will indeed, most surely, behold it with the eye of certainty:
and on that Day you will most surely be called to account for [what you did with] the boon of life!
CONSIDER the flight of time!
Verily, man is bound to lose himself

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
ayahs.translationEn: unless he be of those who attain to faith, and do good works, and enjoin upon one another the keeping to truth, and enjoin upon one another patience in adversity.
ayahs.transliteration: Il lal lazeena aamanu wa 'amilus saali haati wa tawa saw bil haqqi wa tawa saw bis sabr

ayahs.translationEn: WOE unto every slanderer, fault-finder!
[Woe unto him who amasses wealth and counts it a safeguard,
thinking that his wealth will make him live forever!
Nay, but [in the life to come such as] he shall indeed be abandoned to crushing torment!
ayahs.transliteration: Kalla layum ba zanna fil hutamah

ayahs.translationEn: And what could make thee conceive what that crushing torment will be?
A fire kindled by God,
which will rise over the [guilty] hearts:
verily, it will close in upon them
in endless columns!

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
ayahs.translationEn: ART THOU NOT aware of how thy Sustainer dealt with the Army of the Elephant?
ayahs.transliteration: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi ashaabil feel

ayahs.translationEn: Did He not utterly confound their artful planning?
ayahs.transliteration: Alam yaj'al kai dahum fee tad leel

ayahs.translationEn: Thus, He let loose upon them great swarms of flying creatures
which smote them with stone-hard blows of chastisement pre-ordained,
ayahs.transliteration: Tar meehim bi hi jaaratim min sij jeel

ayahs.translationEn: and caused them to become like a field of grain that has been eaten down to stubble
SO THAT the Quraysh might remain secure,
secure in their winter and summer journeys,
Let them, therefore, worship the Sustainer of this Temple;

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
ayahs.translationEn: who has given them food against hunger, and made them safe from danger.
ayahs.transliteration: Allazi at'amahum min ju'inw-wa-aamana hum min khawf

ayahs.translationEn: HAST THOU ever considered [the kind of man] who gives the lie to all moral law?
ayahs.transliteration: Ara-aital lazee yu kazzibu bid deen

ayahs.translationEn: Behold, it is this [kind of man] that thrusts the orphan away,
and feels no urge to feed the needy.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa la ya huddu 'alaa ta'amil miskeen

ayahs.translationEn: Woe, then, unto those praying ones
whose hearts from their prayer are remote
those who want only to be seen and praised,
and, withal, deny all assistance [to their fellow-men]!
BEHOLD, We have bestowed upon thee good in abundance:
hence, pray unto thy Sustainer [alone], and sacrifice [unto Him alone].
Verily, he that hates thee has indeed been cut off [from all that is good]!
SAY: "O you who deny the truth!
"I do not worship that which you worship,
and neither do you worship that which I worship!
"And I will not worship ~hat which you have [ever] worshipped,
and neither will you [ever] worship that which I worship.
Unto you, your moral law, and unto me, mine!"
WHEN GOD'S SUCCOUR comes, and victory,

ayahs.arabic: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
ayahs.translationEn: and thou seest people enter God's religion in hosts,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ra-aitan naasa yadkhuloona fee deenil laahi afwajah

ayahs.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
ayahs.translationEn: extol thy Sustainer's limitless glory, and praise Him, and seek His forgiveness: for, behold, He is ever an acceptor of repentance.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa sab bih bihamdi rabbika was taghfir, innahu kaana tawwaaba

ayahs.translationEn: DOOMED are the hands of him of the glowing countence: and doomed is he!
ayahs.transliteration: Tab bat yadaa abee Lahabinw-wa tabb

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
ayahs.translationEn: What will his wealth avail him, and all that he has gained?
ayahs.transliteration: Maa aghna 'anhu maaluhu wa ma kasab

ayahs.translationEn: [In the life to come] he shall have to endure a fire fiercely glowing;
ayahs.transliteration: Sa yas laa naran zaata lahab

ayahs.translationEn: together with his wife, that carrier of evil tales,
[who bears] around her neck a rope of twisted strands!
SAY: "He is the One God:
"God the Eternal, the Uncaused Cause of All Being.
"He begets not, and neither is He begotten;
"and there is nothing that could be compared with Him.
SAY: "I seek refuge with the Sustainer of the rising dawn,
"from the evil of aught that He has created,
"and from the evil of the black darkness whenever it descends,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa min sharri ghasiqin iza waqab

ayahs.translationEn: "and from the evil of all human beings bent on occult endeavours,
"and from the evil of the envious when he envies."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa min shar ri haasidin iza hasad

ayahs.translationEn: SAY: "I seek refuge with the Sustainer of men,
"the Sovereign of men,
"the God of men,
"from the evil of the whispering, elusive tempter
"who whispers in the hearts of men
ayahs.transliteration: Al lazee yuwas wisu fee sudoorin naas

ayahs.translationEn: "from all [temptation to evil by] invisible forces as well as men,"
